official_site_checks: Official trending API /api/trending/day?limit=10 returned HTTP 200 with ten ranked entries on 2026-09-24; /api/trending/{week|month|all}?limit=10 are exposed as well. Regression fixtures preserve the server order for the daily feed. Live /browse pages label the author facet Creator and demonstrate author= and artist= routes. Dynamic genre names/slugs continue to come from the BrowseFilters payload. Version 10 registers ImageRequestProvider for cdn.asurascans.com, adds the source-site Referer, and validates the official HTTPS host offline; no image bytes or device runtime were checked. Version 11 registers PageDescriptionProvider and annotates both authenticated API and public HTML reader pages with their one-based original order; offline fixtures verify labels without extra requests. Version 12 uses Aidoku UpdateStrategy::Never for completed series and keeps periodic refresh enabled for ongoing, hiatus, cancelled and unknown statuses; fixture coverage verifies the status mapping. Version 13 copies the current series cover into chapter thumbnails and fixtures verify present and missing covers. Version 14 fills Chapter.language with en, consistent with the English-only source manifest; fixture checks the field. Version 15 uses the official trending API limit of 100 for day, week, month and all-time listings; live API requests returned 100 ranked items for each period. Offset/page parameters are ignored, so listings remain single-page. Version 16 enables config.breakingChangeVersion=12 for the existing Asura manga-key migration; fixture verifies the threshold and old/current manga and chapter key mappings. This covers installs older than v12 without migrating v12+ installs. Version 17 adds the login-only Hide Bookmarked search check to match the official BrowseFilters behavior. It uses the existing paginated /api/me/bookmarks endpoint, matches series slugs to manga keys, preserves result order and caches the full bookmark set for five minutes; login and logout clear the cache. Offline fixtures cover filter registration, key matching and cache expiry. No authenticated account response or device rendering was available for verification.
